name: Mount Esja to Steinn
why: Reykjavík's own mountain: 20 minutes from the city, up to the big stone Steinn with the bay, the city and Snæfellsjökull on a clear day.
book: Free. Car park and café Esjustofa at Mógilsá, 10 km north of Reykjavík on the Ring Road; bus 57 stops at Esjurætur.
water: Tap and toilets at the car park; streams on the lower path. Carry 1 litre.
dangers: Steep gravel and steps in the last part; icy from October, ice spikes needed in winter.
Rockfall above Steinn: the path to Þverfellshorn is for experienced hikers.
turnaround: Steinn is the turning point for most walkers; go on to Þverfellshorn only in good weather and dry rock.

points.name: Esjustofa at Mógilsá
points.note: Car park, café and toilets at the foot of Esja; the path crosses a footbridge and climbs along the Þvergil gully.

points.name: Halfway board above Þvergil
points.note: About 300 m up: Kollafjörður, the islands and Reykjavík spread out below.

points.name: Steinn
points.note: About 600 m: a lone boulder with a guestbook under the cliffs of Þverfellshorn.
